content:
Last week, many current Apple products saw discount offers, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, but the deals aren't over yet. While the above discounts are still valid, Amazon has just dropped the price of Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 to an all-time low — starting at just $20 each.

We reported on the all-time low price offer for the new-generation AirTag 2 last week as part of the anniversary sale discounts, but if you missed it, don't worry — the price has now dropped even further, setting the lowest record since we've been tracking it.

Amazon is still selling a single AirTag 2 for $24 — matching the lowest price since its launch — but the 4-pack has been reduced to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official price for the 4-pack is $99, already better value than the $29 single unit price; now it's roughly 20% off, an all-time new low, meaning each AirTag 2 costs only about $20.

Although the previous $90 offer for the 4-pack is likely to be maintained throughout the anniversary sales period at major retailers in theory, Amazon's new low price is different — we don't know when the price will go back up.

We've previously done a detailed comparison between the old-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 — you can catch up here — here are the key points for everyone:

  • Precision finding range is 1.5 times farther than before
  • Volume is 50% louder than the previous generation
  • You can hear the AirTag 2 sound from twice the distance
  • Equipped with "a series of industry-first anti-tracking protection features"

New AirTag 2 features coming soon

AirTag 2 reduced to $20 each, coinciding with the launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27 next month. For Apple Watch users, there's also a nice upgrade this time: the Find My app has added precision finding support. This means you can now use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and specific distance information to locate your AirTag.

watchOS 27 will also unify the Find My experience within a single app. Previously, the Find My features on Apple Watch were split into three separate icons on the app list or grid — for finding people, items, and devices respectively.

As for iOS 27, new design and interface changes have been added to the Find My app, making it easier to find people and things.

Taking all these factors into account, this price is absolutely the best time to expand your AirTag 2 collection.
